notes.title: End them, Soldier! Release Date
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600889/1d4ef042f398f41769829d041940a81d19a92117.png"][/img][/p][h1]End Them, Soldier! is almost there![/h1][p][/p][p]The time is near! [b]End Them, Soldier![/b] is entering the final stretch of development. On [b]November 7, 2025[/b], you’ll finally face the relentless hordes unleashed on Earth by the Terralith energy.[/p][p]Also, there is a new Release Date Trailer with some new gameplay episodes and highly variable [b]perk-system[/b] shown in it.[/p][previewyoutube="1Mk02EYCbdo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I’ve almost completed all the major work on the game:[/p][list][*][p]All campaign and "master" levels are finished.[/p][/*][*][p]Rogue-like game mode is fully playable with online leaderboard to check your place among other players (and me, I play it a lot).[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon and ability balance fine-tuned for maximum intensity. But it's always a place for future balance patches ;)[/p][/*][*][p]Final polish to visuals, sound, and animations is almost done aswell.[/p][/*][/list][p]Hope you'll like the game as much as I do.[/p][p][b]Be prepared to slay all the hordes of undead on November 7, 2025.[/b][/p]
